newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Samsung Electronics plans Israel office.
newsitem.headline: Samsung Electronics plans Israel office.

text.p: South Korea's Samsung Electronics will open a representative office in Israel in May, Israel's Industry and Trade Ministry said on Wednesday.
The decison comes as a 19-member Samsung delegation visits Israel and holds meetings with more than 120 Israeli companies, most of them in telecommunications and multimedia, the ministry said.
In a meeting with ministry officials, Samsung said it expected to set up scores of joint projects with Israeli companies in the wake of the visit. The comany already has 11 joint projects.
The delegation will be meeting Industry and Trade Minister Natan Sharansky on Thursday, the ministry said.
